name: Dennis Andres
bio: Dennis Andres is a German-Canadian actor and stuntman. He is best known for playing one of the lead roles of Ian Matthews on the CBC and Netflix hit show Workin' Moms.

credits.title: Keeper of the Cup
credits.overview: Three delayed Toronto Maple Leafs fans take matters into their own hands to ensure a win in what remains of their lifetimes.

credits.title: An Inseparable Christmas
credits.overview: Two lifelong friends embark on a hometown holiday walking tour that leads to unexpected romantic possibilities with a former travel crush and a recently divorced neighbor.

credits.title: Second Chance Holiday
credits.overview: Dating expert Chelsey (Ayesha Curry) is determined to break her so-called “curse” of always getting dumped during the holiday season. But when fate reunites her with her high school flame (Matthew Daddario), she wonders if her bad luck might just be the universe’s way of leading her back to her first love.

credits.title: Behind Closed Doors
credits.overview: A murder suspect on the run forces his way into Morgan's home and holds her family captive. She does everything she can to keep them safe, but it seems his arrival at her door may not have been so random after all.

credits.title: My Daughter Was Taken
credits.overview: After witnessing her daughter's abduction during a video call, a former prosecutor races home from Spain, only to become the next target. Hunted by someone who thinks she saw too much, she must risk everything to stay alive... and save the one person she can't live without.

credits.title: Don't Trust the Quiet Ones
credits.overview: A divorced mom finds her daughter’s favorite influencer murdered after a mall event. Reporting suspicious behavior puts her family in danger, prompting her ex to take them to a snowy cabin. But the threat may be closer than she thinks.

credits.title: Relative Danger
credits.overview: After her sister is brutally attacked, Angie must fight to protect her niece from dark family secrets and a killer determined to claim her.

credits.title: Montana Mavericks
credits.overview: Heather is a New York City girl and a best-selling author on a mission to conquer writer’s block and avoid paying back an advance on her next book. credits.title: Juliet & Romeo
credits.overview: Set at the dawn of the fourteenth century, a revisionist adaptation of history's most celebrated star-crossed lovers rejects classical iambic pentameter in favor of a contemporary pop music score, charting their efforts to alter the course of their tragic destiny and expose a political truth crucial to the future of th

credits.title: Christmas in the Spotlight
credits.overview: A pop star named Bowyn hasn’t found Mr. Right, until she meets Drew, a professional football player, backstage at one of her shows. When Drew publicly declares he has a crush on Bowyn, they decide to give dating a shot. Their feelings grow stronger, but can it last in the limelight?

credits.title: Fitting In
credits.overview: A teenage girl gets diagnosed with a reproductive condition that upends her plans to have sex and propels her into exploring unusual methods to have a sex life, challenging her relationships with everyone in her life, but most importantly, herself.

credits.title: The Wedding Rule
credits.overview: Former childhood friends are bequeathed a restaurant where they met as teens on one condition: they must be married to claim the inheritance. Both single, the race is on to find the "one" but sometimes it can be right in front of you.

credits.title: Styled with Love
credits.overview: Moving from small-town Iowa to Chicago, an ambitious personal-stylist hires a professional photographer to help promote her new fashion venture; a partnership which teaches her that when it comes to finding love and success in the city, all you need to do is stay true to the style in your own heart.

credits.title: An Autumn Romance
credits.overview: When librarian Taylor Harris suddenly loses her job, she decides to visit her brother in a small town in Montana. There, she gets involved in the fight to help save her brother's hotel from tycoon Joel Sheenan, who wants to renovate it.

credits.title: Hint of Love
credits.overview: A cookbook literary agent with culinary training is tasked with helping elevate the brand of a food channel personality known for his convenience-oriented recipes. credits.title: Feel the Beat
credits.overview: After failing to make it on Broadway, April returns to her hometown and reluctantly begins training a misfit group of young dancers for a competition.

credits.title: Blueprint to the Heart
credits.overview: Interior designer trying to save her home renovation show needs to apply her successful, upscale "fixer upper" home renovation strategy to her blue collar carpenter by making the sweet but disheveled guy her next fixer upper project.

credits.title: A Wakefield Project
credits.overview: The veil between the living and the dead has lifted for 24 hours, would you survive?

credits.title: No Escape Room
credits.overview: A father and daughter check out a small town escape room and discover there is something sinister about the place.

credits.title: Defective
credits.overview: Set in the near future where Rhett Murphy and his estranged sister Jean are forced to flee from a militant police state after witnessing the dark secrets of a nefarious corporation.

credits.title: The Apostle Peter: Redemption
credits.overview: Tormented by his denial of Christ, Peter spent his life attempting to atone for his failures. Now as he faces certain death at the hand of Nero, will he falter again, his weakness betray him or will he rise up triumphant in his final moment?

credits.title: Bed of the Dead
credits.overview: Four twentysomethings find themselves stuck on a haunted antique bed where leaving means suffering a gruesome death. Plagued with frightening hallucinations, they must figure out the bed's secrets before they are ultimately picked off one by one.

credits.title: Lady Psycho Killer
